# Taxi Bhai — Umrah Taxi Service

> Affordable 24/7 private Umrah taxi service in Makkah (Mecca), Madinah, and Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Airport transfers, hotel-to-hotel transfers, and Ziyarah (sacred site) tours. Fixed fares, 100% private vehicles, 5.0 Google rating.

## Business

- **Name:** Taxi Bhai
- **Category:** Private taxi / Umrah transport service
- **Rating:** 5.0 ★ (Google Reviews, 8 verified reviews)
- **Availability:** 24/7, 365 days a year including Ramadan and Hajj season
- **Service model:** 100% private — no shared vehicles or passengers
- **Booking method:** WhatsApp (primary), phone call, or email

## Contact

- **WhatsApp / Saudi Arabia:** +966 57 306 7785

## Service Area

Makkah (Mecca) · Madinah Al-Munawwarah · Jeddah · Taif · Badr · Saudi Arabia

Airports served:
- King Abdulaziz International Airport, Jeddah (IATA: JED)
- Prince Mohammad bin Abdulaziz International Airport, Madinah (IATA: MED)

## Fleet (vehicles available)

| Vehicle | Capacity |
|---|---|
| Camry / Sonata (sedan) | 1–3 passengers |
| Hyundai Staria (MPV) | Up to 7 passengers |
| GMC Yukon XL (SUV, new model) | Up to 7 passengers |
| Toyota Hiace (minibus) | Up to 12 passengers |
| Coaster (coach) | Up to 30 passengers |
| Full-size Bus | 30+ passengers |

## Pricing Table (SAR — Saudi Riyals)

All prices are fixed fares. No meters, no surge pricing, no hidden charges.

| Route | Camry/Sonata | Staria | GMC (new) | Hiace | Coaster | Bus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Jeddah Airport → Makkah Hotel | 250 | 350 | 550 | 400 | 800 | 800 |
